notes.title: Multiplayer Open Beta branch is now live!
notes.notes:
[h2]Heroes,[/h2]

It's about time [b]we share with you a piece of what we've been working on for the last couple of months[/b]. Many of you await it, and we couldn't wait to give it to you as well. And today, we're finally launching open beta tests for the multiplayer mode of CountryBalls Heroes. We would love for you to participate in them and let us know what do you think about the current state of the game. 
[b]
[b]Multiplayer is now Live on Beta branch! [/b]
[h2]How does multiplayer work in CountryBalls Heroes?[/h2][/b]
Just like in good old classic Heroes of Might and Magic! Click on "Multiplayer" in the main menu. Create the game and [b]choose from different scenarios, lobby types, and game difficulty levels[/b]. Choose combat speed, game speed, and turn duration. Pick your faction and hero, and [b]invite your friends to join[/b]! See for yourselves if Poland can into space, or fight each other till memes tear you apart - the choice is up to you!

[h2]How to access the multiplayer open beta tests?[/h2]
[b]To access the new beta branch, please do the following steps:[/b]
1. Right-click on the "CountryBalls Heroes" game in your Steam library and pick the "Properties..." from the list. 
2. Go to the "BETAS" tab, and fine Open Beta type.
3. Select "openbetabranch" from the list above. 
4. Wait until the game update is over. Your beta for CountryBalls Heroes multiplayer is ready to start!

All right, you're ready to go! [b]Gather your friends and see who will be the mightiest of you all![/b]

We'll keep this Open Beta Branch Open for next few weeks (till we'll polish & fix bugs ) 

May the balls be with you!
CountryBalls Heroes team

notes.title: Release Date Postpone - more information inside
notes.notes:
Hello!

Today we have planned to inform you that everything is good and the game is coming to you according to the plan.
Unfortunately, we're coming with bad news. The Steam support informed us that its crew needs more time to review the game. Usually, it takes from 3 up to 5 days. In this case, we received a recommendation from Steam to change the game's launch date because they won't be able to review CountryBalls Heroes in time. 
Therefore, we need to postpone CountryBalls Heroes' premiere. 

**The game is 100% complete, and it has been ready for you for a couple of weeks**. However, Steam procedures require that we wait at least 21 days before setting the new launch date. Therefore, we've decided to change the date to Q4 of 2021 and give you some more specific information on the premiere's day once Steam's review is complete and we have a green light. 

We are aware that many of you awaited this game, and you're probably as heartbroken as we are right now. We have some good news as well, though. There were a lot of discussions about making this delay up to you somehow. Finally, we came up with an idea to use this time to create one more playable map. You'll receive a bit more content in exchange for some more patience. 

**What's more, initially, we wanted to give you a launch discount of 15% on the day of the game's premiere. In this case, we've decided to change the discount to 20%. Again, anything to make this prolonged wait up to you! **

**Finally, we will use this time to start working on the multiplayer mode that you've been requesting a lot!**

Stay with us, and remember that without you, we won't be able to protect all those vodka supplies!
Your CountryBalls Heroes team

notes.title: Demo Update. Patch 2.0
notes.notes:
[b]Hello folks![/b]

Here we are with another patch and 300 bug fixes! All of them are based on the feedback we received from you after the Steam Next Festival. At this point we would like to thank you for all your support. Without you any supplies of vodka (ummm, in-game ones, of course) would not be properly secured.

Now it works just like in HoMM Hota & HoMM 5. 
However - certain specific functionality might not yet be implemented, we'll add them before the release ( most of them ).
[b]City: [/b]
[list]
[*] Added new Window: Show All Castle Units
[*] Added new Window: Buy All Units
[*] Added new Button: Delete Unit
[*] Added new Button: Split Unit 
[*] Clicking on Unit Portrait (Left Panel) will now Open This Unit Recruit Window
[*] Right-Clicking on Unit Portrait will now show Unit Description. 
[*] To activate specific Buttons ( Market, Heroes, BuyAllUnits) your Castle needs to Have a specific building. 
[*] In order to activate Buttons: Split/Delete units -> Select certain Unit 
[*] Select + Shift& Click will pop Split window 
[/list]

[b]World:[/b]
[list]
[*] You can now click on Castle ( World ). 
[*] However by separating,, move to castle” Selected Unit will. You have to directly send them to the City entrance.

[*] Added: Button: Delete Hero
[*] Added Button: Skill Points 
[/list]

City Name -> City names were Kinda pointless. So we rid them off. 

[b]Tooltips: [/b]
[list]
[*] Right-clicking on Certain Icon will show 
[*] Everything which glows -> Got the description. 
[*] 
[/list]
[b]Tip:[/b]
[list]
[*] If your Hero Dies, you can recruit a new one in
[*] To do that -> Go to the castle -> Buy Hero Tavern -> Buy Specific Hero.
[/list]

[b]Resolution Support[/b]
[list]

[/list]

[list]
[*] You can now click on Minimap to move Main Camera

[b]Save/Load system has been implemented (Beta) [/b]

*Dev Note. Autosave & Renaming Save Files will be added at the release

*This feature won’t be available in the demo. 

[b]Added – Translations system[/b]
* Till release, only the English language will be supported.

[b]Balance[/b]
[list]
[*] Russian Faction have been nerfed by roughly 10%

[list]
[*] Building GUI should now correctly open

[*] In certain conditions Bears should no longer shot with vodka

[/list]

We know that there are still a few bugs, we will try to fix them before release. Thank you for your submissions!

[b]On top of everything there will be 1 more small patch with: [/b]
[list]
[*] Tutorial

[/list]

We'll make an announcement later this month.

notes.title: Kickstarter campaign is over, this is just the beginning.
notes.notes:
[b]Kickstarter Campaign [/b]
Kickstarter campaign is over, leave the rest to us.
Countryballs Heroes reached over 107% of the planned goal! This is the perfect foundation for our little game, we were very close to reach the next goal so who knows, we might add more stuff to the base game. 

[b]Community Voting [/b]
Soon, we will send an email (with a survey) to our Kickstarter Supporters.
Up there you will have a chance to choose your favorite country. 
Countries with the highest amount of votes will receive extra units and heroes.
Countries with the most votes will get additional units and heroes.
The list of countries that we are currently planning to implement - you will find in the survey!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35185996/0a1a9ff8ff9d7d0f6626ba469c51e7fc2c55f1b4.gif[/img]

[b]Voting Power[/b]
How does the Voting Power work?
Depending on the support you showed us during the campaign, you will receive a special Voting Power 
Two countries with the most votes win – they’ll receive extra units & heroes.
 
[b]Example:[/b]
Person A had a chance to get Gameball for a total of 13 Voting Power.
We multiply the person A vote by 13. 

Person B had a chance to get Gameball for a total of 20 Voting Power.
We multiply the person B vote by 20.

I hope it is pretty clear how it works. 
The community survey will be open until 14.12.2020

[b]SuperBakers[/b]
Soon we’ll send emails with more information to our special supporters. Prepare your ideas by then!  

[b]Release date[/b]
If everything goes well, Countryballs Heroes will be released in around Q2 2021.

Of course, the release date may change. The base is a good game.

[b]Feedback & Alpha build[/b]
Thank you very much for the work you have put in writing your feedback. Based on your feedback, we will try to improve the game, that’s why…

[b]… Poland will gain new - reverted colors![/b]
Therefore, based on your feedback, the Polish faction will also receive correct -> inverted colors.
From now on, there will be two Poland. Poland A and Poland B. 
Which is which, we're not going to reveal!
